description: Governor's Office Western Province - Entertainment Tax Ordinance - Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte M.C. and Horana U.C.
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the approval and notification of tax ordinances (Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946 and its amendments) and references the Provincial Councils (Auxiliary Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989. The core subject matter is the legal framework for imposing and amending a tax, which falls squarely under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal amendments). While a government official (the Governor) is named, this is only in their capacity to issue the legal notification; the content does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory act itself.
